def policy_peer(req, peer_name, gw):
    peers = gw.get('peers') or {}
    if peer_name not in peers: return reject('unauthenticated')
    if not req.pai: return reject('unauthenticated')
    authority = set(peers[peer_name] or [])
    idents = set()
    for claim in req.pai:
        ident = alias_map.get(claim)

        idents.add(ident)
    if len(idents) != 1: return reject('identity')
    sel = idents.pop()
    if domain_of(sel) not in authority: return reject('identity')
    for claim in ([req.from_uri] if req.from_uri != ANON else []) + ([req.ppi] if req.ppi else []) + ([req.rpid] if req.rpid else []):
        if alias_map.get(claim) != sel: return reject('identity')
    return accept(sel, 'peer', private)
